criteria.evidence_ref: previous_state=uninitialized; bootstrap_preset=deny-all; reason=prerequisite for pre-G4 sandbox verification gates; init exit 0; policy ls after init exit 0; governance=unknown/not observable from sbx policy ls --json

criteria.description: exact sbx and Claude Code versions written into runtime/versions.yaml

notes: Observed by gates/G0/run.sh from the documented sbx JSON surfaces, against the observed sbx v0.43.0 candidate (it becomes the V1 pin only once G0 passes and runtime/versions.yaml records it). No credential value is read or recorded. G0 initializes the global network policy to the conservative deny-all bootstrap preset only when sbx reports it uninitialized, because a preset is required before the first sandbox runs (G6) and G4 runs later; an existing policy or governance state is recorded and left unchanged. G4 remains authoritative for the effective policy.
